hotels.title: Dominican Republic All-Inclusive Beachfront Paradise with Unlimited Dining & Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Escape to Marriott’s first-ever all-inclusive W resort, bringing the brand’s signature high-energy, playful design to Punta Cana’s stunning beachfront. At this adults-only escape, modern style meets Caribbean ease, with oversized rooms and suites, private balconies and select swim-up or plunge-pool options. Explore a curated all-inclusive dining and mixology experience across 12 restaurants and bars, from Dominican-inspired dishes at Scena to Pan-Asian favourites at Noodle Bar and rooftop dining at Satsuma. Spend sunlit hours beside the 80-metre oceanfront infinity pool, then discover the vinyl and vintage arcade games tucked inside 33 1/3 Speakeasy. Sunrise yoga, live entertainment and local-culture experiences bring the resort’s vibrant spirit to every part of your stay, while AWAY Spa offers a more tranquil change of pace.
